SET:K_i.meaning: possible interception attempts for target i

SET:F_ij.meaning: feasible sensor-weapon pairs for target i at attempt j

PARAM:alpha_is(t_k).meaning: sensor visibility indicator for sensor s detecting/tracking target i at time k

PARAM:beta_iw(t).meaning: weapon engagement-envelope indicator for weapon w engaging target i at launch/intercept time

PARAM:C_s_max.meaning: maximum tracking channel capacity of sensor s

PARAM:M_w_load.meaning: missile inventory / launch capacity of weapon w

PARAM:Delta_t_w_reload.meaning: minimum reload time between successive launches from weapon w

PARAM:T_i_impact.meaning: predicted impact time of target i

PARAM:t_iw_flight.meaning: flight time of weapon w against target i for an assigned engagement

PARAM:t_is_track.meaning: sensor tracking time requirement before engagement/lock

PARAM:P_kill.meaning: kill-probability function based on miss distance and sensor accuracy

VAR:x_iswk_j.meaning: 1 if target i attempt j is assigned to sensor s and weapon w at discrete time k

VAR:sigma_is_jk.meaning: 1 if sensor s tracks target i during attempt j at time k

VAR:omega_iw_j.meaning: 1 if weapon w is assigned to target i for attempt j

VAR:gamma_i_j.meaning: 1 if attempt j against target i is executed

VAR:tau_i_j.meaning: launch time for attempt j against target i

DERIVED:P_i_j(X).meaning: interception probability for target i attempt j

DERIVED:P_i_total(X).meaning: total interception probability of target i under the plan

CONGRP:ASSIGNMENT_CONSISTENCY.meaning: each target-attempt-time is assigned to at most one sensor-weapon pair; assignment variables are linked to sensor and weapon decisions

CONGRP:SENSOR_CAPACITY_VISIBILITY.meaning: sensor channel capacity and visibility constraints for target tracking

CONGRP:WEAPON_RESOURCE_RELOAD.meaning: weapon inventory limits and minimum reload time between launches from the same weapon

CONGRP:TEMPORAL_COORDINATION.meaning: launch plus flight must occur before target impact; sensor tracking/lock must precede launch/engagement

CONGRP:ENGAGEMENT_ENVELOPE.meaning: weapon can only be assigned when target is inside its kinematic engagement capability

CONGRP:VARIABLE_DOMAINS.meaning: binary domains for assignment, sensor, weapon and activation variables; valid launch-time domains

SEMANTIC:MULTISOLUTION_PORTFOLIO_BOUNDAR.meaning: multi-solution is output portfolio guidance, not a diversity objective

SEMANTIC:unsupported_explicit_diversity_.meaning: explicit diversity objective replacing interception objective

SEMANTIC:unsupported_generic_static_sens.meaning: generic static sensor-target and weapon-target variables without attempt/time indices

SEMANTIC:unsupported_cost_risk_timelines.meaning: cost/risk/timeliness multiobjective vector not in this paper's MS-SWTA core formulation

SEMANTIC:unsupported_omitting_sensor_tra.meaning: omitting sensor tracking, weapon reload or engagement-envelope constraints

SEMANTIC:unsupported_turning_multimodal_.meaning: turning multimodal landscape Eq. (13)-(14) into hard constraints for one candidate solution
